note: Hand-maintained milestone states, from docs/plan.md. Update the state and 'now' line when a milestone moves; PROGRESS.md is regenerated on every commit.

milestones.title: State and recovery gate
milestones.now: 91 partitions and all 6 GPTs read back and hash-verified. Waiting on an EDL full dump of every partition and a proven restore route before any boot or flash.

milestones.title: Kernel baseline
milestones.now: Linux 7.3 and XEC 7.3-rc4 build reproducibly; NX809J board DTS candidate (patches 0001-0004) compiles with 0 schema errors and 3 inherited warnings. No temporary boot yet.

milestones.title: Safe foundation (UFS, USB, battery, thermal, watchdog)
milestones.now: Static maps only: UFS PHY (102 registers match), thermal (55 TSENS IDs match), ADC/battery reviewed. Nothing run on the phone.

milestones.title: Phone and dock hardware
milestones.now: 0 of 20 hardware rows tested on the phone. Touch, panel, GPU and remoteproc analysis is done on the host.

milestones.title: Denial desktop
milestones.now: Denial ARM64 packages and the integrated Debian 13 + Mesa 26.1.6 rootfs pass offline checks. No phone session yet.

milestones.title: Dual boot and switching
milestones.now: Blocked on M0/M1: no proven temporary-boot path and no safe internal root area yet. Android slot A stays untouched.

milestones.title: Completion
milestones.now: Every hardware row must pass its phone test, plus five clean Android-Linux-Android cycles.
